canada.title: Montreal police officer suspended over alleged misconduct toward vulnerable person

canada.title: Nova Scotia paying $31K a month for stalled New Waterford health-care centre project
canada.summary: The NDP says it has obtained documents showing the PC government has been paying a construction company $31,555 a month for a health-care centre project that has been paused.

canada.title: Prime Minister Mark Carney visits Yorkton, Sask., ahead of December byelection
canada.summary: The last time a sitting prime minister stopped in Yorkton was in 2010, when Stephen Harper visited the area after devastating flooding.

canada.title: N.L. apologizes, says it now accepts Innu history dates back more than 300 years
canada.summary: The Grand Chief of the Innu Nation says Newfoundland and Labrador Premier Tony Wakeham has apologized following a months-long controversy over the Innu's history in Labrador.

canada.title: Man accused of racist tirade caught on video in a Halifax box store pleads not guilty
canada.summary: The lawyer for 37-year-old Randall Publicover pleaded on behalf of his client in Halifax provincial court today.

canada.title: Supreme Court of Canada to hear challenge of law central to Ontario land dispute
canada.summary: OTTAWA - The Supreme Court of Canada has agreed to hear a developer's constitutional challenge of an Ontario law at the heart of a dispute over land in a protected area known as the provincial Greenbelt.

canada.title: Igloolik boil water advisory lifted, fourth year of high turbidity around same time
canada.summary: The territory issued the advisory more than four months ago due to cloudy water, or high turbidity. It’s the fourth year the community has been asked to boil its water for high turbidity around the same time of year.

canada.title: Chignecto Isthmus flood protection work to be complete by 2034, minister says
canada.summary: A project that’s meant to protect the narrow, low-lying strip of land that connects Nova Scotia to New Brunswick could be complete by 2034, according to Nova Scotia Public Works Minister Fred Tilley.

canada.title: Flooding triggers evacuation order for dozens in Cedar, near Nanaimo
canada.summary: Dozens of properties were placed under evacuation order in the community of Cedar Thursday, and multiple areas of Vancouver Island are under evacuation alert, as a series of storms continue to drench B.C.'s coast.

canada.title: Striking Harbour Grace community centre workers say town won't agree to wage demands
canada.summary: Workers at a Harbour Grace recreational facility are going on strike after failed contract negotiations with the town.

canada.title: Health officials reflect on ‘lasting impact,’ heroic response following CFB Wainwright fire
canada.summary: More than a month after a deadly fire engulfed a training range at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, Alberta health officials are expected to provide an update on the soldiers still recovering from the flames.

canada.title: KDgate for Montreal mayor continues with website mocking Kraft Dinner comments
canada.summary: Controversy in a box: Montreal Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada’s Kraft Dinner comments spark website, impromptu protest at city hall.

canada.title: 2 arrested after investigation into series of home invasions across GTA: Peel police
canada.summary: Two people have been charged as the result of an investigation into an alleged spree of home invasions, Peel Regional Police announced Thursday. Multiple charges related to the robberies, as well as illegal firearms, drugs and possession of child sexual abuse material have been laid, and police expect more arrests to come.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News + CP24, CityNews (CP)

canada.title: Up to 9 hours of freezing rain in forecast for N.B., warning says
canada.summary: Much of the province, including central, western and northwestern regions of New Brunswick, has an Environment Canada freezing rain warning in effect.

canada.title: Evacuation orders, alerts issued as flood risks mount on Vancouver Island
canada.summary: Nanaimo has issued an evacuation order south of the city for some properties along the Nanaimo River in the community of Cedar, with residents told to leave immediately.

canada.summary: Acute Care Alberta says 19 soldiers are still being cared for in provincial hospitals, with seven listed in critical condition.
